name: Nae Wang-eul Wihayeo
source:
When a man wishes for another's future to be changed, he must pay the ultimate price, yet for his king.... It is worth. However, this prices comes to an inconvenience to another. Will this be your fate? To suffer the one he gave in order to fulfill another's? 

Or will you be able to break the cycle and do what he knows he cannot? And save his King.

[From [url=https://ohhue.itch.io/for-my-king]Itch.io[/url]]
